audio.music_mood: Gentle relaxing acoustic guitar melody with ambient undertones

content.concept_description: A player solves an arrow maze puzzle where guiding spools of thread transforms maze lines into an embroidered portrait of the Girl with a Pearl Earring before encountering an error.
content.cultural_reference: Girl with a Pearl Earring (Vermeer painting recreated in embroidery)
content.why_it_works: The tactile, ASMR-style embroidery transformation creates immediate visual satisfaction, while an abrupt failure late in the ad activates ego threat and prompts viewers to download and solve it themselves.

visuals.primary_color: Black #000000, Embroidery Gold #D99B26, Coral Pink #C44E52, Leaf Green #4C8C2B, White #FFFFFF
visuals.notable_characters: Embroidered portrait of Girl with a Pearl Earring
visuals.notable_objects: Thread spools, embroidery maze paths, flower petals, pearl earring

emotions.emotional_arc: Calm and mesmerizing thread unspooling shifts to abrupt frustration when red warning borders flash on a wrong move.

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Players trace and unspool colored thread along arrow-directed maze paths to fill in an intricate embroidered artwork.

chapterization.chapter_description: Green thread smoothly unspools through the maze to form flower stems.
Successive threads unspool across hair and skin, revealing the embroidered portrait.
A thread encounters a blocked path, flashing a red error border repeatedly.
Color Maze logo displays over a carousel of art levels with a green Play CTA button.
